optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Procurement Lead, Indirect and Packaging Spend

professionalSummary.text: Procurement specialist with experience leading supplier consolidation and tendering in indirect categories.
professionalSummary.witness: "the driving force behind our supplier consolidation"

experienceHighlights.text: Ran three competitive tenders for facilities services under the company procurement policy, each scored by a two‑person evaluation panel.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Ran three tenders for facilities services (cleaning, waste collection and pest control) under the company procurement policy, each scored by a two-person evaluation panel."

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained supplier master data in SAP Ariba and completed onboarding checks including insurance certificates, food‑contact declarations and bank detail verification.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Kept supplier master data in SAP Ariba and completed onboarding checks: insurance certificates, food-contact declarations and call-back verification of bank details."

experienceHighlights.text: Led the packaging‑consumables consolidation program, issuing the request for quotation to 14 suppliers, building price and lead‑time comparison, and drafting the award paper presented to the sourcing board.
experienceHighlights.witness: "on the packaging-consumables consolidation, issued the request for quotation to 14 suppliers, built the price and lead-time comparison and drafted the award paper that the category manager took to the sourcing board."

experienceHighlights.witness: "Produced the quarterly contract-renewal and spend report for budget holders, flagging contracts within 90 days of expiry"

experienceHighlights.text: Cleared the monthly purchase‑order exception list with accounts payable.
experienceHighlights.witness: "cleared the monthly purchase-order exception list with accounts payable"
